course.title: Unit 4 Then and now-Part B--【例句】

sentences.content: You’re wearing a pink T-shirt. Yes, but I don’t like pink now.
sentences.english: You're wearing a pink T-shirt . Yes , but I don't like pink now
sentences.chinese: 你穿了件粉色T恤。是的，但我现在不喜欢粉色了。
如今的我们已截然不同！

sentences.content: Before, I was quiet. Now, I’m very active in class.
sentences.english: Before , I was quiet . Now , I'm very active in class
sentences.chinese: 以前，我很安静。现在，我在课堂上非常活跃。

sentences.content: I was short, so I couldn’t ride my bike well. Now, I go cycling every day.
sentences.english: I was short , so I couldn't ride my bike well . Now , I go cycling every day
sentences.chinese: 我以前个子矮，所以骑不好自行车。现在，我每天都骑车。

wordDetails.definition: cycle（现在分词）: 骑自行车

sentences.content: I didn’t like winter before. I thought it was too cold.
sentences.english: I didn't like winter before . I thought it was too cold
sentences.chinese: 我以前不喜欢冬天，觉得它太冷了。

sentences.content: Now I love to ice-skate, so I like winter.
sentences.english: Now I love to ice-skate , so I like winter
sentences.chinese: 现在我很喜欢滑冰，所以我喜欢冬天。

sentences.content: Allen couldn’t go cycling before. Now he goes cycling every weekend.
sentences.english: Allen couldn't go cycling before . Now he goes cycling every weekend
sentences.chinese: Allen以前不会骑自行车。现在他每个周末都去骑车。

wordDetails.definition: go（第三人称单数现在时）: 去

sentences.content: She could ice-skate well when she was young.
sentences.english: She could ice-skate well when she was young
sentences.chinese: 她年轻时滑冰滑得很好。

sentences.content: He can play badminton very well now.
sentences.english: He can play badminton very well now
sentences.chinese: 他现在羽毛球打得非常好。

sentences.content: My hair was long before. Now it’s short.
sentences.english: My hair was long before . Now it's short
sentences.chinese: 我以前头发很长，现在剪短了。
